Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our architecture. The code is available at https://github.com/hito2448/Res2CLIP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Res²CLIP，一种面向少样本通用异常检测的残差到残差对齐框架，通过将多模态对齐转移到统一的残差空间，同时解决了跨粒度不匹配和跨类别泛化退化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP-based方法存在两大问题：粗粒度统一文本提示难以适应细粒度前后景差异（跨粒度不匹配）；在辅助数据集上微调会因域偏移破坏CLIP的开放世界泛化能力（跨类别泛化退化）。
AI.method: 提出残差到残差对齐框架Res²CLIP，将多模态对齐完全转移到统一的残差空间。框架包含三个分支：文本提示分支、视觉提示分支、以及新颖的残差到残差对齐分支。所有可学习优化都约束在残差域内，并通过残差对齐优化目标迫使模型关注相对异常偏差而非优化类别特定特征。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验验证了该架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对称地在CLIP残差空间中桥接视觉和文本模态，Res²CLIP同时解决了跨粒度匹配和跨类别泛化两大挑战，为少样本通用异常检测提供了有效方案。

title: MAgSeg: Segmentation of Agricultural Landscapes in High-Resolution Satellite Imagery using Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Agricultural landscape segmentation in the Global South is challenging as it is characterized by fragmented plots, high intra-class variance, and a scarcity of labeled training data. Recent advances in segmentation have been made by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, current approaches encounter critical context length bottlenecks and a domain alignment gap in understanding satellite features. We address these limitations through MAgSeg, a novel, decoder-free MLLM segmentation approach. MAgSeg is an architecturally efficient approach that enables standard MLLMs to perform segmentation of complex smallholder agricultural landscapes from high-resolution satellite imagery, without requiring auxiliary vision decoders. We introduce a novel instruction tuning data format designed to enable scalable fine-tuning and post-training on high resolution satellite imagery, which enables MAgSeg to learn from the global context of the image while generating text tokens for only a patch within the image. Extensive evaluations on datasets spanning three countries in the Global South demonstrate that MAgSeg significantly outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM baselines, offering a scalable solution to map smallholder agricultural environments.

AI.tldr: MAgSeg是一种无需辅助视觉解码器的新型多模态大语言模型（MLLM）分割方法，专门用于解决南半球小农农业景观的高分辨率卫星图像分割难题，在三个国家的数据集上显著优于现有MLLM基线。
AI.motivation: 南半球农业景观分割面临地块碎片化、类内方差大、标注数据稀缺等挑战，现有MLLM方法存在上下文长度瓶颈和卫星特征领域对齐差距，亟需更高效、可扩展的分割方案。
AI.method: 提出MAgSeg，一种无解码器的MLLM分割架构，通过设计新颖的指令微调数据格式，使标准MLLM在保持全局上下文理解的同时，仅对图像中的某个patch生成文本token，实现高效的高分辨率卫星图像分割。
AI.result: 在横跨三个南半球国家的数据集上，MAgSeg显著优于当前最先进的MLLM基线方法，验证了其在小农农业环境映射中的可扩展性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: MAgSeg为南半球复杂小农农业景观的高分辨率卫星图像分割提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，通过架构简化和数据设计创新有效解决了MLLM在该领域的上下文长度瓶颈和领域对齐问题。

title: Probabilistic Dating of Historical Manuscripts via Evidential Deep Regression on Visual Script Features
summary: We introduce a probabilistic approach for dating historical manuscript pages from visual features alone. Instead of aggregating centuries into classes as is standard in the previous literature, we pose dating as an evidential deep regression problem over a continuous year axis, allowing our neural network to output a full predictive distribution with decomposed aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. Our architecture combines an EfficientNet-B2 backbone with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG) output head trained with a joint negative-log-likelihood and evidence-regularization objective. On the DIVA-HisDB benchmark (150 pages, 3 medieval codices, 151,936 patches), our model scores a test MAE of 5.4 years, well below the 50-year century-label supervision granularity, with 93\% of patches within 5 years and 97\% within 10 years. Our approach achieves \textbf{PICP=92.6\%}, the best calibration among all compared methods, in a single forward pass, outperforming MC Dropout (PICP=88.2\%, 50 passes) and Deep Ensembles (PICP=79.7\%, 5 models) at $5\times$ lower inference cost. Uncertainty decomposition shows aleatoric uncertainty is a strong predictor of dating error (Spearman $ρ=0.729$), and a selective prediction about the most certain 20\% of patches can provide \textbf{0.5 years MAE}. We show that predicted uncertainty increases as image degradation worsens, spatial decomposition maps explain which script regions cause aleatoric uncertainty, and page-level aggregation reduces MAE to 4.5 years with $ρ=0.905$ between uncertainty and page-level error.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于视觉特征的历史手稿页面概率定年方法，通过证据深度回归输出包含偶然不确定性和认知不确定性的完整预测分布，在DIVA-HisDB基准上实现了5.4年的测试MAE和92.6%的PICP校准性能。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将世纪聚合成类别进行离散分类，无法提供连续年份预测和不确定性量化，本文旨在实现连续年份回归并同时输出不确定性估计。
AI.method: 采用EfficientNet-B2骨干网络结合Normal-Inverse-Gamma (NIG)输出头，通过联合负对数似然和证据正则化目标训练，实现单次前向传播输出完整预测分布并分解偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
AI.result: 测试MAE为5.4年（低于50年的世纪标签粒度），93%的patches误差在5年内，97%在10年内；PICP=92.6%（优于MC Dropout的88.2%和Deep Ensembles的79.7%），推理成本降低5倍；最确定的20% patches实现0.5年MAE；页面级聚合MAE降至4.5年。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在校准性和效率上显著优于现有方法，不确定性分解有效，偶然不确定性与定年误差强相关（Spearman ρ=0.729），且不确定性随图像退化程度增加而上升，可提供空间级不确定性解释。
